item.title: Collapsible Rigid Boxes
item.description: Press the corners and the box clicks open into a structure that feels like it cost three times what it did to ship. The grey board core holds firm. The printed wrap sits flush. The lid closes with the kind of resistance that communicates quality before the product inside is even considered.
